commits.author: Raja Kolli
commits.message:
Refactor Kafka configuration and improve Redis update performance (#2678)

* Refactor Kafka configuration and improve Redis update performance

- Renamed eventsTopic method to applicationTopics and removed events topic creation from KafkaConfig.
- Updated PostCommandService and PostCommentCommandService to perform asynchronous updates to Redis, improving performance by avoiding blocking the main execution path.
- Added Cache configuration properties to AppProperties for local cache size management.
- Updated application-local.properties and application-production.properties to include new cache settings and optimized Kafka producer configurations.
- Enhanced load testing configuration by introducing mutable and deletable pools for posts and comments, and adjusted traffic weights for various operations.
- Implemented new MutationFeeder class to handle CSV data feeding for mutable and deletable posts and comments.
- Updated scenarios for posts and comments to include update and delete operations, ensuring comprehensive load testing coverage.
- Adjusted integration tests to reflect changes in Kafka topic names and improved observability metrics.

* Implement code review comments

* Document high-RPS cache and Kafka methods

* Update boot-high-rps-sample/src/main/resources/application.properties
